page.notes: Ink smudges and stains in the left margin beside the lines "fum cum cerebro" and "fa materialis" are not printed text and are left out. Doubtful readings: "hibetur" (first word, possibly "habetur"); long s in "sit"/"sa" is read as a plain s on the basis of the sense; "vaporofa" is read as printed.
